task:
Implement a focused production-quality PLAYER COMBAT pass for Maples, a browser-native Three.js action-RPG. Return ONLY a canonical unified diff for the selected existing files. Do not add files. Preserve unrelated behavior and existing public interfaces used by RowanAnimationDirector and polish layers.

Make Character the authoritative source for Rowan action state/timing while Game resolves consequences in the world. Preserve state, stateTime, stateDuration, comboIndex, dead, invuln, speed, facing, position, beginAttack, beginDodge, takeDamage, update, and the one-shot melee hit query/event. Reduce duplicate combat clocks in Game rather than adding a new controller.

Required feel: crisp three-hit sword chain with distinct startup/active/recovery, reliable 150-200ms attack input buffer, clean combo continuation/reset, exactly one melee hit event per swing, meaningful heavier finisher, and real-time buffer/cooldown semantics that remain correct during hit-stop. Give attacks controlled combo-specific forward commitment without freezing movement or allowing accidental 180-degree active-frame turns. Add fair late-recovery dodge cancel windows with explicit i-frames but retain commitment. Spell remains deliberate and keeps mana/cooldown contracts.

Upgrade hit confirmation using the existing FX/audio/camera hooks only when real hits occur: restrained tiered hit-stop, camera kick/shake, slash/burst/ring response, stronger finisher, cleaner projectile impact, and subtle audio variation. Do not fake hits. Avoid new per-frame geometry/material allocation; reuse existing FX geometry where practical. Preserve desktop pointer lock, mobile simultaneous movement+actions, camera, encounter progression, HUD, loot/XP, assets, world collision, spawning, and balance. Do not modify enemy FSM logic in this pass except Game-side hit consequences that are necessary for player actions. Keep the code browser-native and readable.
